identification: French Louis Philippe silver 5 francs 1833, mint mark W (Lille), about Fine, drilled and hinged as a folding manicure tool (file, scissors, blade) on chain and keyring with tan leather pouch. Keyring has a small stamp possibly DEPOSE. Coin holds silver about 22.5 g at 900 fineness, so melt is a floor of modest size; the value above that is novelty collectability.
